fk_selfcheck_note: No Blender re-bake available (no Blender binary on this box); bound from the 574 control fit (exact joints 0.13 deg). spine_note: Spine quats use the best 2-factor sandwich (Hip=ZXY, Spine1=XYZ); 53.5 deg max / 17.8 deg mean error on the 574 control. No exact Spine model was found (diagnose-control3-10).

orientation_fix.what: Hips joint ONLY rebuilt with the joint 574+578 sandwich; all other 20 joints, root_t and root_motion_fwd_m copied verbatim from the original receiver JSON.
orientation_fix.why: The original Hips sandwich (U,V,W) was fit ONLY on clip 574, where E_BASE is a qz-only 1-DOF family. That fit has a 1-parameter degeneracy (U,V,W)->(U.qz(a),qz(-a).V,W) that leaves 574 exact for every a but maps out-of-family E_BASE arbitrarily. The receivers' f0 BASE raw quat is [0,-1,0,0] (180 deg yaw, out of family), so their f0 Hips came out ~180 deg about Z (upside down) — an artifact of the optimizer's arbitrary a~0, not game data.
orientation_fix.method: Joint least_squares fit of (U,V,W) on bank 574 + bank 578 Hips (both independent ground truth from the real applier+bake); fit cost 1.26e-11; 574 max 0.1303 deg, 578 max 0.1264 deg. Unique: identical (U,V,W) from orig/identity/random starts. Hold-out 588 (never fitted): Hips max 0.1278 deg, vs orig fit max 178.75 deg on 588.
orientation_fix.source: lane-e-wireup rebuild-all.py; c8 from game sampler (sample-593.npz); joint sandwich joint-sandwich.json
